name: Contrel Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Contrel Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells LCD equipment in Taiwan and China. The company offers mini LED test, repair, laser drilling, tile laminating equipment, collage equipment, mass transfer, laser trimming, and metal repair; sealant ultraviolent, nano protusion, photo alignment ultraviolet, ultrasonic dry cleaning equipment; macro and exterior inspection, burr check, electric test, PAD inspection, light on test, and demura inspection; pack/unpack, RTP/RTS and TFT/CF/LCD factory conveyance.
